sink.description: String concatenation into SQL query passed to Db.exec

flow.description: User input read from query parameter
Passed to Db.exec as raw SQL

finding.description: User-controlled input from HTTP query parameter is concatenated directly into a SQL query string without parameterization.
finding.suggested_fix: Use Caqti prepared statements with typed parameters instead of string concatenation.

results.evidence_notes: Source is user-controllable (Dream.query parameter). Sink is Db.exec with string concatenation. Flow path fully traced with file and line evidence. No sanitization present.

preconditions: The reviewed Dream handler is reachable over HTTP
source_to_sink_trace: src/main.ml:12 concatenates id into the SQL string
src/main.ml:14 passes the raw SQL to Db.exec
proof_by_construction.expected_impact: An attacker can alter the WHERE clause and read or modify unintended rows.
